units.text: UNTC source confirms 27 January 1980 entry into force for Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties worldwide.

judgement.reason: The passage from UNTC supports the 27 January 1980 entry-into-force date, but it does not explicitly identify the treaty as the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties or state worldwide application.

units.text: Wikipedia span 92 confirms 'Effective | 27 January 1980' for the convention.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passage contains the exact text '| Effective | 27 January 1980 |' and supports the effective date for the convention, but it does not identify or confirm 'Wikipedia span 92' or that this specific span contains that text.

units.text: Wikipedia span 120 states the convention became effective on 27 January 1980, worldwide.

citations.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: The passage supports the effective date of 27 January 1980, but it states 119 sovereign states have ratified, not 120, and does not state the convention became effective worldwide.
